sanskrit: ā rohata janitrīṃ jātavedasaḥ pitṛyānaiḥ saṃ va ā rohayāmi | avāḍ ḍhvyeṣitā havyavāha ījānaṃ yuktāḥ sukṛtaṃ dhatta loke ||
english: Mount the mother, O Jātavedas; by the paths of the Fathers I cause you all to mount. Sent forth upward, O bearer of oblations, yoked ones — bestow upon the sacrificer a place of good deeds in the world.

sanskrit: devā yajñam ṛtavaḥ kalpayanti haviḥ puroḍāśāṃ sruco yajña āyudhāni | tebhir yāhi pathibhir devayānair yair ījānāḥ svargaṃ yanti lokam ||
english: The gods and the seasons arrange the sacrifice — the oblation, the rice-cakes, the ladles, the implements of the rite. Travel by those god-traversed paths by which sacrificers go to the heavenly world.

sanskrit: ṛtasya panthām anu paśya sādhv aṅgirasaḥ sukṛto yena yanti vradhnasya viṣṭapy adhi vi kramasva yatrādityā amṛtam īkṣayanti ||
english: Look well upon the path of cosmic order along which the Aṅgirases, the doers of good, travel. Step upward across the expanse of Vṛadhna to where the Ādityas behold immortality.

sanskrit: trayaḥ suparṇā uparasyāsakhāyū nākasya pṛṣṭhe adhi viṣṭapi śritāḥ | svargā lokā amṛtena viṣṭā kāmaṃkāmaṃ yajamānāya duhrām ||
english: Three fair-winged birds, two companions of the one above, are perched upon the vault of heaven at the zenith of the firmament. May the heavenly worlds, suffused with immortality, yield every wish for the sacrificer.

sanskrit: juhūr dādhāra dyām upahṛd antarikṣaṃ dhruvāṃ dādhāra pṛthivīṃ pratiṣṭhām | pratimā lokānāṃ ghṛtapṛṣṭhā prapīnāṃ svadhām ūrjaṃ yajamānāya duhrām ||
english: The Juhū ladle has upheld the sky; the Upahṛt ladle has upheld the atmosphere; the steady one has upheld the earth as a foundation. The image of the worlds, whose back is ghee, richly swelling — may it yield refreshment and strength for the sacrificer.

sanskrit: dhruva ā roha pṛthivīṃ viśvavedasam antarikṣam upahṛd ā kramasva | juhu dyāṃ gaccha yajamānena sākaṃ sruvena vatsena diśaḥ prapīnāḥ sarvā dhukṣā ahṛṇīyamānāḥ ||
english: O Dhruvā, mount the earth, all-knowing; O Upahṛt, stride into the atmosphere; O Juhū, go to the sky together with the sacrificer and the sruva ladle as a calf. Milk all the directions fully, without resentment.

sanskrit: tīrthais taranti pravato mahīr anu yajñakṛtaḥ sukṛto yena yanti | atrābhajaṃ yajamānāya lokaṃ diśo bhūtāni mayi kalpayanta ||
english: By the sacred fords they cross the great flowing streams; this is the path by which the performers of sacrifice, the doers of good, travel. Here I have assigned a world to the sacrificer; may the directions and all beings find their fulfillment in me.

sanskrit: aṅgirasām ayanaṃ pūrvo agnir ādityānām ayanaṃ gārhapatyo dakṣiṇānām ayanaṃ dakṣiṇāgniḥ | padmānam agner vihitasya brāhmaṇā samaṅgaḥ sarva upa yāhi śagmam ||
english: The eastern fire is the pathway of the Aṅgirases; the Gārhapatya fire is the pathway of the Ādityas; the southern fire is the pathway of the southern ones. O Brahmin, come to the lotus-arrangement of the fire as it has been set up, whole and complete, in auspiciousness.

sanskrit: pūrvo agnis tvā tapatu śaṃ purastāc chaṃ paścāt tapatu gārhapatyaḥ | dakṣiṇāgnis tapatu śarma varma- -uttarato madhyato antarikṣād diśodiśo agne pari pāhi ghorāt ||
english: May the eastern fire warm you with bliss in front; may the Gārhapatya warm you with bliss behind; may the southern fire warm you with shelter and protection — from north, from middle, from the atmosphere. O Agni, guard us from every quarter from the dreadful.

sanskrit: yūyam agne śantamābhis tanūbhir ījāno abhi lokaṃ svargam | aśva bhūtvā pṛṣṭivāho vahātha yatra devaiḥ sadhamādaṃ madanti ||
english: You, O fires, with your most beneficent forms — the sacrificer [goes] toward the heavenly world. Having become horses, back-bearing carriers, you carry him to where the rejoicing takes place together with the gods.

sanskrit: śam agne paścāt tapa śaṃ purastāc cham adharāt tapa jātavedaḥ | ekas tredhā vihito jātavedaḥ samyaṅ enaṃ dakṣiṇāgniḥ ||
english: O Agni, warm with bliss from behind, with bliss from in front, warm with bliss from below, O Jātavedas. Jātavedas, one but distributed threefold — may the southern fire completely encompass him.

sanskrit: padmānam agner vihitasya brahmaṇā samaṅganaṃ dhehi sukṛtām ulokam | tam agnayaḥ samiddhā ā bharantāṃ prajāpatyaṃ medhyaṃ jātavedasaḥ | śṛtaṃ kṛṇvanta iha mā vi cakṣaṇan ||
english: By the brahman power, establish for the lotus-arrangement of the fire set in place the world of the doers of good perfectly joined. May the kindled fires bring to it the Prajāpati-offering, the consecrated oblation of Jātavedas. Making it cooked here, may they not look away.

sanskrit: yajña eti vitataḥ kalpamāna ījāno abhi lokaṃ svargam | tam agnayaḥ sarvahutaṃ juṣantāṃ tam asmiṃ devā jānatāṃ bhāgadheyam ||
english: The sacrifice goes forth fully extended, being arranged; the sacrificer [goes] toward the heavenly world. May the fires take pleasure in it as the all-offered oblation; may the gods in this very place recognize his portion and share.

sanskrit: ījānaś cittam ārukṣad agniṃ nākasya pṛṣṭhaṃ divam utpatiṣyan | tasmai pra bhātu nabhaso jyotiṣīmān svargaḥ panthā vitaro devayānaḥ ||
english: The mind of the sacrificer has mounted Agni, about to fly upward to the vault of heaven, to the sky. May the luminous heavenly path, broad and god-traversed, shine forth from the sky for him.

sanskrit: agnir hotādhvaryuṣ ṭe bṛhaspatir indro brahmā dakṣiṇatas te astu | huto 'yaṃ saṃsthito yajña etu yatra pūrvam ayanaṃ hutānām ||
english: May Agni be your Hotṛ-priest and Adhvaryu; may Bṛhaspati and Indra be your Brahmin-priest on the right. This sacrifice, having been offered and concluded, let it go to where the prior pathway of the offered oblations leads.

sanskrit: apūpavān kṣīravāṃś carur eha sīdatu- -uttabhnuvan pṛthivīṃ dyām ivopari | lokakṛtaḥ pathikṛto yajāmahe ye devānāṃ ghṛtabhāgā iha stha ||
english: Let the rice-cake cauldron here, containing milk-porridge, take its seat — propping up the earth as the sky [props up] what is above. We worship you who are world-makers and path-makers, you who here are the ghee-portions of the gods.

sanskrit: apūpavān drapsavāṃś carur eha (…) ||
english: Let the rice-cake cauldron here, containing drop-offerings, take its seat [— propping up the earth as the sky props up what is above. We worship you who are world-makers and path-makers, you who here are the ghee-portions of the gods].

sanskrit: apūpavān dadhivāṃś carur eha (…) ||
english: Let the rice-cake cauldron here, containing curds, take its seat [— propping up the earth as the sky props up what is above. We worship you who are world-makers and path-makers, you who here are the ghee-portions of the gods].

sanskrit: apūpavān ghṛtavāṃś carur eha (…) ||
english: Let the rice-cake cauldron here, containing ghee, take its seat [— propping up the earth as the sky props up what is above. We worship you who are world-makers and path-makers, you who here are the ghee-portions of the gods].

sanskrit: apūpavān māṃsavāṃś carur eha (…) ||
english: Let the rice-cake cauldron here, containing meat, take its seat [— propping up the earth as the sky props up what is above. We worship you who are world-makers and path-makers, you who here are the ghee-portions of the gods].

sanskrit: apūpavān yavavāṃś carur eha sīdatu- -uttabhnuvan pṛthivīṃ dyām ivopari | lokakṛtaḥ pathikṛto yajāmahe ye devānāṃ ghṛtabhāgā iha stha ||
english: Let the rice-cake cauldron here, containing barley, take its seat — propping up the earth as the sky props up what is above. We worship you who are world-makers and path-makers, you who here are the ghee-portions of the gods.

sanskrit: apūpapihitān kumbhān yāṃs te devā adhārayan | te te santu svadhāvanto madhumanto ghṛtaścutaḥ ||
english: The pots covered with rice-cakes that the gods have held up for you — may those be yours: rich in ancestral refreshment, honey-sweet, dripping with ghee.

sanskrit: yās te dhānā anukirāmi tilamiśrāḥ svadhāvatīḥ | tās te santu vibhvīḥ prabhvīs tās te rājānu manyatāṃ yamo akṣitaṃ bhūyāṃsam ||
english: These parched grains mixed with sesame that I scatter for you, full of ancestral refreshment — may they be abundant and mighty for you; may King Yama approve them for you that you may grow inexhaustibly great.

sanskrit: drapsaś caskanda prathamām anu dyām imaṃ ca yonim anu yaś ca pūrvaḥ | ṛtasya yonim anu saṃcarantaṃ drapsaṃ juhomy anu sapta hotrāḥ ||
english: The drop has fallen toward the primeval sky, toward this womb here, and toward that which is the former one. The seven offerers pour oblation in succession to the drop that travels along the womb of cosmic order.

sanskrit: śatadhāraṃ vāyum arkaṃ svarvidaṃ nṛcakṣasas te abhi cakṣate rayim | ye gṛṇanti pra ca yakṣanti sarvadā te duhrate dakṣiṇāṃ saptamātaram ||
english: The seers who behold mankind look upon your wealth — the hundred-streamed wind, the hymn, the one who knows the sun. Those who praise and honor [it] always — they milk the southern one, the seven-mothered, for their sacrificial fee.

sanskrit: utsan duhanti kalaśaṃ caturbilaṃ mṛḍāṃ dhenuṃ madhumatīṃ svastaye | ūrjaṃ madantīm aditiṃ janeṣv agne mā hiṃsīḥ parame vyoman ||
english: They milk the spring, the four-holed pot, the gracious cow full of honey, for well-being. O Agni, do not harm Aditi, who is exhilarating strength among the people, in the highest heaven.
